seo_description: Dev tool that fixes broken Wwise integration after Perforce pulls. One click, all references restored.
hero.title: Wwise Unreal Engine Fixer
hero.subtitle: Dev Tool / Automation / Batch Script, Python GUI, Perforce Workflow
about.text: Perforce kept breaking Wwise. Every pull, same story: paths gone, actors silent, 20 minutes of manual fixing before anyone could test audio. Got tired of it. I wrote a tool that scans the project, finds the broken Wwise references, restores the plugin settings, and rebuilds the configs. One click. It backs everything up with a timestamp first, so nothing gets lost. Batch scripting for the core logic, Python for the GUI. The whole Shadow Frames team ran it after every Perforce sync.
how.title: How it works
how.scan_desc: Walks through .uasset and config files looking for Wwise references that point to nothing.
how.fix_desc: Restores plugin settings, updates configs, rebuilds asset references. All automatic.
how.backup_desc: Timestamps your project before touching anything. If something goes wrong, you roll back.
features.title: Features
features.logging_desc: Every file change gets logged. You can see exactly what it touched and why.
features.precision_desc: Won't mess with anything else. Your Blueprints, meshes, levels stay exactly as they were.
features.teams_desc: Ran it daily on Shadow Frames with the full team pulling from Perforce. It held up.
